resume.headline: Senior Videographer & Video Producer | Filmmaker | FAA Part 107 Drone Pilot
resume.summary: Senior videographer and video producer with seven-plus years shooting, lighting, and editing brand films, documentaries, interviews, and social video. Runs productions end to end, from storyboards, scripts, and budgets to Sony FX, RED, and Canon cameras, FAA Part 107 drone work, Adobe Premiere Pro edits, and DaVinci Resolve color. Commands crews of 5 to 20 and delivers 98% of projects on time.

jobs.title: Owner / Producer
bullets: Commanded crews of 5 to 20, partnered with CEOs and executives, and managed quotes and budgets; delivered 98% of projects on time and 92% within budget.
Accelerated enrollment 2x for a large charter school over one year by leading a video content creation initiative.
Crafted cinematic documentaries, interviews, and brand films for construction, trades, and remodeling clients; storyboards cut back-and-forth by over 50%.
Shot on Sony FX cameras, lit with Aputure, and graded S-Log3 in DaVinci Resolve; reached over a million people on YouTube teaching post-production.

jobs.title: Media Specialist
bullets: Created and led a video initiative that raised click-through rates for running ads by over 200%.
Led a social media content initiative that earned more than 20x the engagement of standard content.
Grew the video library 7x and refreshed photo and video on every school website, lifting site engagement.
Built AI content workflows with Claude that cut production time in half; planned the role of video in enrollment with executives.

jobs.title: Video Producer (Part Time)
bullets: Deployed RED and Canon cameras daily and piloted a DJI Mavic 3 drone, working with Communications teams across both chambers.
Rebuilt color grading workflows to run 3x faster in DaVinci Resolve with Canon Log-3 and RED Wide Gamut footage.
Documented prominent figures including Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and the AZ Speaker of the House.

jobs.title: Videographer
bullets: Delivered 200+ videos over two years that reached millions on TV, paid social, and organic channels, including an alumni campaign shown during NCAA basketball games.
Directed cinematography for higher-end brand shoots every quarter and architected the team's online stock footage library.
Scripted original organic content with the marketing team and crafted professionally lit interviews for healthcare and theology audiences.
Ran over $1 million of in-house gear, including Sony FX3 and FX6 systems, Aputure lighting and grip, and DJI Inspire 2 drones.

jobs.title: Photography Teacher
bullets: Trained 80+ beginners to 95% camera operation proficiency and stewarded a $30k equipment inventory.

education.degree: Master's in Marketing, Marketing Analytics Specialization
